load_blaser_model: load a BLASER model by name using the backward-compatible loader function
get_blaser_model_hub: get a BLASER model hub accessor for loading models from the fairseq2 model registry
create_blaser_model: create a BlaserModel MLP with configurable embedding dimensions, hidden layers, and activation
run_blaser_forward: run a BLASER model forward pass with source, machine translation, and optional reference embeddings
featurize_blaser_input: featurize BLASER input embeddings using COMET or QE input form transformations
